name: cam-execution-gateway
description: Fail-closed, instance-targeted read-only query and dry-run preview review for CAM.

interface.shortDescription: Review bound CAM queries and dry-run previews.
interface.longDescription: Adds a fail-closed gateway for instance-bound read-only queries and dry-run previews. It blocks live execution, Journal dispatch, NC, G-code, postprocessing, and machine control.
defaultPrompt: Audit this CAM request and keep it read-only or dry-run.
